envelope.reason: the assayer asked whether indent-and-trailer fidelity is enough

payload.title: uninstall restores host files byte for byte
payload.body: Ruled: under uninstall ('nothing the host placed or changed itself'), a file the host had before install comes back byte for byte, line endings and layout included, as the top-level uninstall already does. Restoring only its indent and trailer leaves a file the host never wrote. Applies to eventTap uninstall's settings restore (tap-uninstall-restores of remaining-gaps).
